runtime_identity: host.id from required PRIME_INTERFACE_HOST_ID; runtime_version from PRIME_INTERFACE_RUNTIME_VERSION; candidate_status from PRIME_INTERFACE_CANDIDATE_STATUS. Version/status default UNKNOWN; explicit host and candidate/qualification labeling is required for test listeners. These labels do not themselves establish deployment or qualification.
error_normalization: Dedicated app.interface_server returns protocol/error.code/error.message/error.retryable; it never reflects raw request inputs or exception text. X-PRIME-Protocol header identifies protocol. Ambiguous errors never authorize automatic replay.

transport.pin_algorithm: SHA-256 of DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo; lowercase hexadecimal
transport.pin_trust: Dell must compare the TLS peer SPKI to an independently adopted pin; the identity body is not a trust anchor.
transport.deployment: Requires real certificate/private-key reference and trusted TLS listener. Do not expose legacy /api/interface/v1 or owner routes to thin clients. No TLS or firewall configuration changed by this implementation.
transport.fixtures: ASGI TestClient https base_url is a local transport simulation, not a TLS roundtrip.

policy_fields.expires_at: Unix seconds, must be in future
policy_fields.capabilities: explicit list of allowed interface operations

authentication.ownership: Existing interface requests SQLite store associates each task to its authenticated client; cross-client access returns404.

request_fields.deterministic_operation: optional sha256, json_format or json_validate; uses existing dispatcher and retained parent task identity

routes.response: existing PRIME objective status, steps and source-labelled advisory results

routes.mode: single bounded current-state snapshot per connection
routes.resume: Last-Event-ID equal to snapshot digest returns no duplicate event; reconnect obtains current state
routes.limitation: Not durable full history; intermediate transitions between polls can be missed. No process-wide ledger exposure.

routes.response: Existing shared queue cancellation request, not independent proof of completed cancellation

routes.materialization: A terminal task snapshot is materialized on demand through existing ArtifactFactory and reused on reconnect. Existing objective-store transaction serializes concurrent requests; no new store. Unfinished tasks generate no placeholder.
routes.limitation: Task snapshot is source-labelled results, not an independent correctness claim.

routes.validation: Factory rehash before serving; Dell must hash received bytes independently

routes.ownership: Existing task owner or explicitly linked same owner account only
routes.semantics: Terminal turn only; reserve revision before dispatch. Conflicting or uncertain reserved replay is never executed automatically. Preserved original objective and additive turns share parent task identity.

task_semantics: Existing single shared objective/queue state. Logical contributions do not imply verified arbitrary tool execution.
continuation_artifacts: Task status and SSE expose revision; steps retain revision labels. Artifact listing exposes latest_result_artifact_id for terminal current snapshot; prior artifacts remain immutable. No upload references or client model/authority selection on continuation.
